subject_need: Make Quality Intent Framework operational and AI-verifiable
alternative_solutions: Documentation-only framework: create a human-readable model without executable validation.
Schema-plus-validator framework: create docs, canonical JSON schemas, example package, and a validator for AI/human verification.
Application-first framework: build a full workflow application before stabilizing the conceptual contract.
non_solution_options: Continue using review counts, test counts, page counts, or expert opinion as direct substitutes for quality.
defer_options: Delay implementation until more industry-specific project histories exist.
stop_options: Do not create a project if the validated need collapses into software-test-only tooling or volume-metric scorekeeping.
